headline: Stlican Shelf and Coastal Fronts Erupt in Fresh Base Contests
war_summary: Base exchanges have shifted sharply eastward and along island sectors, while structural transitions have stalled in Linn of Mercy and Stonecradle despite sustained casualties. Stlican Shelf has become a primary flashpoint, logging eight base actions and over twenty-two hundred combined casualties in the last two hours across The Pale House, Vulpine Watch, and The Old Mourn. Island operations have similarly reawakened, with Fisherman's Row registering six base actions across Eidolo and Black Well, complemented by six captures across Godcrofts. In Mooring County, combat persists around The Wind Hills and Wiccwalk, generating three base events and nearly nine hundred casualties over two hours. Weathered Expanse remains the conflict's heaviest meat grinder, suffering nearly thirty-eight hundred casualties in the two-hour span amid ongoing pressures at Frostmarch and Crow's Nest. Farranac Coast has also seen renewed movement at The Bone Haft with three base actions, even as Linn of Mercy, Stonecradle, and Dead Lands endure thousands of losses without immediate territorial alteration.
